name: Diaphane UI
description: An open-source, iOS-inspired React component library with a translucent glass look, for prototyping mobile web apps. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

assets.name: Inter (variable)
assets.source: src/fonts/ (subsetted woff2 from @fontsource-variable/inter, licence text included)
assets.fallback: The font stack uses the device's own system font where the platform provides one (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont); no platform font file is bundled.

assets.name: Lucide
assets.source: npm package `lucide`, curated in src/icons/icons.ts; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
assets.fallback: Apps can add or override icons with registerIcons().

aaMode.description: High-contrast palette; every text/background pair passes WCAG AA in light and dark.

accessibility.nativeExceptions: The default palette is below AA for secondary text (3.44:1), white on the default blue (3.52:1 light, 3.23:1 dark) and the default red text (3.57:1). Kept by design for the standard look; use the AA mode when contrast compliance matters.
